hook.name: MiniBTCHook
hook.description: A bonding curve hook for an ETH/MiniBTC pool. Buys mint MiniBTC via a forward curve (with a randomized entropy multiplier during early blocks); sells burn MiniBTC and pay ETH from accumulated reserves. Liquidity additions are permanently forbidden; all swap execution is fully taken over by the hook via BeforeSwapDelta. Requires a swapper address ABI-encoded in hookData on every swap.
